why: AZBOTS is a named, reusable low-fidelity arthroscopy training simulator rather than a general instructional element; its instructional approach is an instance of Simulation.
name: AZBOTS low-fidelity benchtop arthroscopy simulator
product_description: A Marui & Co., Ltd. simulator that provides surgical trainees with eight instrument-based arthroscopy task boxes, timed practice, auditory error alarms, and completion scoring.
